summary: I need to FUCKing Dance Be in our Zone. Lick sweat off my face wondering if it's my own. instead flaying my body in my kitchen alone. Still. Joy in my rattling bones #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I
  need
to FUCKing
  Dance
Be in our Zone.

      Lick
sweat off my face
   wondering
if it's my own.

  instead flaying
my body in my kitchen
  alone.
Still.
Joy
in my rattling
  bones
#smallpoems
